turns.question: For customers whose first order was placed in October 2026, what was the median number of days between their signup date and that first order?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: there is no median or average of days from signup to first order. The closest metrics are the signup-to-first-order rate (share of customers who placed their first order within 30 days of signing up, counted on the signup day), signups, and active customers (customers_distinct).
